absent: Locking or concurrency rules for capability detection, activation, and per-processor state access.
Encodings, widths, and reset values of partitioning, streaming, identifier, and interrupt registers beyond the named indicators.
Definitions and behavior of detection helpers, sanitized register accessors, barrier semantics, and system capability query routines.
Activation details for catalogue entries other than partitioning, including ordering across processors and failure handling.
User capability number assignments and the mapping from catalogue entries to user-visible hardware capability bits.

findings.text: Capability probe for memory partitioning and monitoring first asks a feature detection helper whether the processor implements the extension and then confirms that firmware left the privileged control enable asserted on this processor.

Per-processor activation routine for memory partitioning and monitoring that installs saved partitioning state on the calling processor, covering privileged and unprivileged controls and additionally a streaming extension partitioned control when that extension is present system wide.

Activation preserves a per-processor saved value only when build-time support and a runtime branch agree, otherwise starts from a cleared value; it programs privileged state with enable asserted, programs streaming state through a narrow mask, issues an ordering barrier, then programs unprivileged state from the unmodified value while leaving low-privilege synchronization to a later privilege return.
Capability probe for partitioning virtualization support that reads a sanitized partitioning identifier and reports whether the hypervisor control indicator is present.

Capability probe for legacy virtual interrupt interface that fails when the current processor lacks the newer CPU interface capability and otherwise reports the legacy indicator from the interrupt identification register.

System capability catalogue is a statically initialized terminated array where each element optionally carries a description, a capability number, a scope category, a detection callback, an optional activation callback, and optionally identification constraints, a nested match list, or a processor mask pointer.

Catalogue mixes always-present, boot processor, strict boot, system-wide, early local, weak local and restricted local scopes; many elements are conditional on build options, nested virtualization uses a nested terminated list, one element uses a negated identification constraint, a follow-on matrix capability is ordered after its base, and the array ends with an empty terminator.

Feature lifecycle separates detection from activation: detection callbacks evaluate identification fields or custom processor state during capability resolution, and activation callbacks later program processor controls, clear fault state, copy hypervisor state, emulate identification views, or trap unprivileged behavior on each affected processor.

User-visible capability helpers define five recurring entry shapes built from a shared naming and typing fragment: identification-gated entries, plain tagged entries, multi-alternative entries driven by a nested list, custom matcher entries, and entries combining identification gating with a custom matcher override.

Pointer authentication visibility uses two terminated alternative lists, one for address authentication and one for generic authentication, each offering three identification-gated options that distinguish architected revisions from implementation-defined behavior.
Scalable vector and matrix user features are reported only when the corresponding system-wide extension state is already accepted and the entry-specific user identification check also succeeds.

Partitioning ABI facts: privileged control register SYS_MPAM1_EL1 uses enable bit MPAM1_EL1_MPAMEN, unprivileged control is SYS_MPAM0_EL1, streaming partitioned control is SYS_MPAMSM_EL1 narrowed by MPAMSM_EL1_PARTID_D together with MPAMSM_EL1_PMG_D, and virtualization presence comes from SYS_MPAMIDR_EL1 indicator MPAMIDR_EL1_HAS_HCR.
Interrupt ABI facts: newer CPU interface capability gates the check and legacy virtual interface presence is indicated by ICC_IDR0_EL1_GCIE_LEGACY in identification register SYS_ICC_IDR0_EL1.

Activation writes privileged partitioning control even when saved-state support is unavailable, using a cleared value with enable asserted, so final processor state depends on build and runtime gating; streaming control is deliberately narrowed and unprivileged control is written without an immediate ordering guarantee for low privilege.
